statements.text: A 'Senior Member' is defined as any member who has been active for at least 3 years.
All committee members must be Senior Members.
Alice joined the organization on January 15, 2024.
Alice is currently serving on the Finance Committee.
The current date for this audit is February 1, 2026.
A 'Voting Event' is any meeting where policy decisions are made by majority vote.
Voting Events require a minimum quorum of 15 members present.
The March 2025 policy meeting had 12 members present and passed Resolution 47.
Resolution 47 was approved by majority vote.
All documents must be reviewed by at least two department heads before publication.
The organization has exactly three departments: Finance, Operations, and Outreach.
Bob is the only department head in the organization.
An 'Emergency Session' can only be called when normal procedures cannot address an urgent matter.
Emergency Sessions bypass all standard voting requirements.
The annual budget must be approved at a standard Voting Event, never an Emergency Session.
No standard Voting Event achieved quorum in 2025.
The 2025 annual budget was successfully approved in 2025.
A 'Project Lead' must have completed at least 5 approved projects.
Carol has completed exactly 3 approved projects.
Carol was appointed as Project Lead for the Website Redesign initiative.
Members cannot hold more than two committee positions simultaneously.
David serves on the Finance Committee, Operations Committee, and Ethics Committee.
All expense reports over $500 require approval from both the Finance Committee and the Executive Director.
The Executive Director position has been vacant since September 2025.
Emma's $750 expense report was fully approved on December 1, 2025.
A 'Full Quorum' means all active members are present.
The organization currently has 40 active members.
The November 2025 meeting had 35 members present, which was considered sufficient attendance for routine matters.
